description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output with a threshold of 1e-3, comparing the proportion of output values below this threshold before and after gating, as well as after average gating. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and also has a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are shown: a dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate, with an average value of 0.003, starts at approximately 0.003 and remains relatively stable across the x-axis; a dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate, with an average value of 0.126, starts at around 0.7 and decreases to approximately 0.1 by layer 5, then continues to decline gradually to about 0.05 by layer 20; a dash-dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate, with an average value of 0.080, begins at roughly 0.45 and decreases to around 0.05 by layer 5, then remains relatively stable until layer 20.
